answer: Trust propagates via bounded random walks across an attestation graph: each step follows a verified edge, and conductance limits mixing. For a Sybil set S, φ(S)=w(S,\bar S)/vol(S) measures its external cut; if nebula, quartz, and raven form a sparse min-cut, a length-L walk leaks O(Lφ(S)) mass under the conductance mixing bound. Thus internal attestations cannot compound into voting power: aggregate weight is bounded by externally sourced flow.
